run.head: 6c8fde6642cd428e884cc9c9d88c9aaa189c4bf1
run.change_description:
fix(redis2): remove orphaned directory index members on listing

ListDirectoryEntries skipped index members whose value key was gone and
left them in the ZSET, so the per-directory child index grew without
bound under any TTL workload. Mirror the ZRem the logical-expiry branch
already performs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(redis2): keep the index member when a concurrent insert recreates the value

The orphan cleanup removed the member unconditionally, so an InsertEntry
landing between FindEntry and the ZRem left a live value with no index
member, invisible to listings until another InsertEntry on that path.
UpdateEntry does not re-add it, so the loss persisted.

Restore the member when the value is present again after the removal.
The value key and the directory index key hash to different slots, so a
Lua script or MULTI over both is not available to the cluster store.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

summary.intent: Stop `ListDirectoryEntries` from leaving dead members in the redis2 per-directory index: ZRem an orphaned member once its value key is confirmed gone, then restore that member if a concurrent InsertEntry recreated the value before the ZRem lands.
summary.issue_fit: No linked issue; intent is drawn from the supplied PR-description spec (`spec-pr10735-packet`) and the two real commit messages. The core fix and its concurrent-recreate guard are implemented as described, but the guard's own restore step does not honor the PR's stated failure-mode guarantee; see the finding index.
summary.coverage: Both changed files (the 17-line store change and the new 143-line test file) read in full; no other files touched by this range. `go vet`, `gofmt`, and a compile-and-skip `go test` run clean at the reviewed head; the PR's own live-Redis test evidence could not be reproduced offline and was instead traced against base and head code.
check_details: Reviewer ran `go vet ./weed/filer/redis2/...` at the reviewed head: clean, no findings.
Reviewer ran `gofmt -l` on both changed files at the reviewed head: no files listed, both already formatted.

Reviewer ran `go test -count=1 -v ./weed/filer/redis2` at the reviewed head: package builds; all three new subtests report SKIP because `RUN_REDIS_TESTS` is unset and no Redis server is available in this sandbox, per the target's stated execution allowance.

The PR body's own `go test ./weed/filer/redis2/... -race` run against a live `redis-server 8.2.1` could not be reproduced offline; traced the three new tests' setup and assertions against base and head code instead (see requirements ledger).

findings.title: Check the error from the compensating ZAddNX restore
findings.trigger: In the compensating-restore path of `removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember` (`universal_redis_store.go:237-251`), a concurrent `InsertEntry` recreates the value between the caller's `FindEntry` miss and this function's `ZRem`, so the function reaches the restoring `store.Client.ZAddNX(ctx, dirListKey, redis.Z{...})` call at `:250`.
findings.impact: Unlike the `ZRem` (`:238`) and `Exists` (`:245`) calls right above it, this `ZAddNX`'s result is never checked. If it errors, the member stays removed while the value stays live — the same "invisible until another InsertEntry on that path" loss commit 6c8fde664 exists to close — contradicting the PR's own claim that failures here "bias towards a stale member rather than a lost one."
findings.change: Check the `ZAddNX` error and log it, as the sibling not-found branch already does with `glog.V(0)` at `:206`, so a failed restore is visible instead of silently discarded.

observations.fact: `DeleteFolderChildren` deletes each child's value key directly from the ZSET's members without ever `ZRem`-ing them from that same ZSET; it relies on a later `DeleteEntry` call against the parent directory to delete the whole index key instead, unrelated to this diff.

requirements.source: pr-body/"`ZREM` the member in the not-found branch, mirroring what the expiry branch already does below and against the same `dirListKey` variable"
requirements.evidence: universal_redis_store.go:208 calls removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember(ctx, dirListKey, path, fileName) from the not-found branch, reusing the same dirListKey the expiry branch's ZRem (:217) and ZRangeByLex (:189) use.

requirements.source: pr-body/"`dirListKey` is `store.getKey(genDirectoryListKey(...))` at `:178` — already prefixed — and the new `ZREM` reuses that variable instead of rebuilding the key"
requirements.evidence: dirListKey is computed once at :178 via store.getKey(...) and passed by parameter into removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember; the function never recomputes an unprefixed key.

requirements.source: pr-body/"The branch guard is `err == filer_pb.ErrNotFound` — identity, not `errors.Is` — so a connection blip cannot match it"
requirements.evidence: universal_redis_store.go:207 uses `if err == filer_pb.ErrNotFound`; FindEntry (:99-102) returns that bare sentinel only for redis.Nil and wraps every other failure with fmt.Errorf, so a transient error cannot match the identity check.

requirements.source: pr-body/"`isSuperLargeDirectory` makes `InsertEntry` skip the `ZAdd` and `DeleteEntry` skip the `ZRem` ... the new call is unreachable. The feature is unaffected."
requirements.evidence: InsertEntry (:63-71) and DeleteEntry (:131-140) both gate their ZAddNX/ZRem on isSuperLargeDirectory, so a super-large directory's dirListKey never gains members; ListDirectoryEntries's ZRangeByLex (:189-194) then returns empty and the new call never runs.

requirements.source: pr-body/"`doInsertEntry`'s `SET` has returned before `ZAddNX` is issued"
requirements.evidence: InsertEntry (:56-74) calls doInsertEntry (the SET) at :58 and only issues the parent-index ZAddNX at :68 after doInsertEntry returns without error, confirming the ordering the orphan-cleanup design relies on.

requirements.source: pr-body/"a `ZREM` that errors removes nothing and returns, and a re-check that errors restores the member, so the failure modes bias towards a stale member rather than a lost one"
requirements.evidence: The ZRem (:238) and Exists (:245) error paths behave as claimed, but the final restoring ZAddNX (:250) discards its own error instead of biasing towards a stale member; see redis2/zaddnx-restore-error-discarded.

requirements.source: commit-6c8fde664/"Restore the member when the value is present again after the removal."
requirements.evidence: Restoration is implemented via ZAddNX at :250, but its error is discarded, so a failed restore silently leaves the promised restoration undone; see redis2/zaddnx-restore-error-discarded.

Reviewer ran `go vet ./weed/filer/redis2/...` and `gofmt -l` on both changed files at the reviewed head: both clean; `go test -count=1 ./weed/filer/redis2` compiles and all three new tests report SKIP (no live Redis), confirming the package builds and type-checks.

requirements.source: pr-body/"Against `redis-server 8.2.1`, the first three cases fail on master and pass with the change"
requirements.evidence: No live Redis is available in this sandbox (unavailable per the target's execution allowance). Traced the tests instead: TestListDirectoryEntriesRemovesOrphanedIndexMembers and TestListDirectoryEntriesRemovesIndexMembersExpiredByRedis assert the index holds only live names, which the pre-change not-found branch never removed and the post-change removeOrphanedDirectoryListMember does; consistent with, but not an independent reproduction of, the author's reported result.
